verdict.rationale: Baseten documents Model APIs: shared, per-token-billed, OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints for calling hosted language models without deploying them, including a model deprecation lifecycle. That establishes serverless shared endpoints, but no evidence names the catalog's model families or shows how broad it is. Missing for 10: any listing of the supported open-weight families (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS, etc.), evidence of catalog breadth or currency, and independent corroboration.
